title: Automate changelog and onboard nocturne-13b-v1.0 perf/metadata
author: Priya Nair
body: Motivation: Add Nocturne-13B v1.0 to the model registry with curated performance profiles, metadata, and automated changelog generation so onboarding is reproducible and release notes are generated for downstream consumers. Changes: 1) Add models/nocturne-13b/v1.0/metadata.json with authorship, model_artifact pointers, canonical params, and versioning. 2) Add models/nocturne-13b/v1.0/perf_profiles.yaml containing latency/throughput profiles for common batch sizes, sequence lengths, and recommended quantization profiles. 3) Update registry/index.json to reference the new model and include a generated changelog entry. 4) Add scripts/changelog_generator.py which consumes model metadata and perf profiles to produce release notes in markdown and append to registry index. 5) Add tests/test_perf_profiles.py as a smoke regression to ensure new profiles parse and meet minimal expected throughput ranges. 6) Minor CI integration to run perf-smoke on a GPU runner with a short run to validate profiles before merge. Checklist: - [x] metadata schema validated - [x] perf profiles reviewed by SRE and runtime - [x] changelog generator integrated into CI - [x] smoke tests added - [x] docs link updated in registry index Notes: perf profiles were generated from internal lab runs with curated prompt sets and are tagged with dataset and seed. The changelog includes a short summary and guidance to use the recommended quantization and batching settings. This PR is backwards-compatible and non-breaking. See release_notes for the user-facing message.
commits: Add Nocturne-13B v1.0 metadata and perf profiles
Add changelog generator and CI integration
Add perf smoke test and parser validations
Address review feedback: add int8 quantization entry and clarify kernel hints
review_comments: Ethan Liu: Please include the expected 95th percentile latency for the 512 token workload in the perf_profiles.yaml. Also can you add a fallback quantized profile for int8?
Priya Nair: Added 95th pct latency lines and added an int8 profile. Updated commit with comments describing the margin of error and how the smoke job validates the baseline.
Sofia Martinez: Can the changelog generator include the dataset and seed metadata for reproducibility? Also please ensure the generator output is idempotent when re-run.

Priya Nair: Changelog now includes the dataset and seed fields and the generator writes to a temporary file then atomically updates the registry index to keep it idempotent. Added tests for idempotency.
Connor Blake: CI perf-smoke initially failed due to insufficient GPU quota on the runner. Rerun passed after moving to dedicated perf runner. Approved after green CI.
ci_checks: perf-smoke: fail (first run due to GPU quota) -> pass (rerun on perf runner)
merge_details: Merged by Sofia Martinez via squash-and-merge. Commit message: 'Onboard Nocturne-13B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation. Internal perf smoke validations added.'
release_notes: Added Nocturne-13B v1.0 to the Redwood model registry with curated performance profiles and metadata. Use recommended quantization (int8) and batching settings from the perf_profiles.yaml. Changelog entry generated automatically; see registry/index.json for full notes and reproducibility metadata (dataset + seed).
additional_context: Runtime and SRE validated kernel hints used in the perf profile. This PR is the first in a small series to standardize changelog generation for model onboards and will be followed by a migration script to backfill older models. Test harness: short eval set of 50 prompts used for smoke validation.
